scientific_integrity: Exact Hamming tensor decomposition and PBH criterion prove the lower bound; reproducing modular nonzero minors from the full incidence construction proves the attaining placement over rational arithmetic. No independent external mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the fixed unweighted 189-vertex four-dimensional ternary point–line incidence graph, not all dimensions or weights. One minimum placement is constructed, not a classification of all placements. A closely related historical thesis was accessible only by its public abstract, and unidentified prior specialist work remains possible.
title: Exact dedicated controllability of the four-dimensional ternary point–line network
